title: Activate the P11 certified CI artifacts
goal: Install the certified workflow and CODEOWNERS candidates through the declared activation lifecycle without changing their behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow template renders the P11.4-certified workflow body and passes the 13-check CI contract.
Install adds deterministic provenance to the workflow and marker ownership to the existing CODEOWNERS rules without changing their behavior.
The exact trusted-component change consumes its base authorization and passes the base-owned Diff gate plus all 13 real pull-request checks.
Verify passes after merge on codex/guards-principles-plan, and rollback is constrained to the two activation targets.
